My plot is small, only like a small garden, and I grow maize like everyone here in Dedza. Last season I got a coupon for one bag of NPK and one bag of urea from the subsidy — if I get the coupon again this year I will use it, because without it I cannot afford fertilizer from the shop. I put the small manure I have from my goats, and I plant the seed my cousin saved, with pumpkins between the maize rows. I do the work myself with my wife and the older children, no money to hire anyone.
